subject: Renewal + Reserved Pool Top-up — credit/terms for 6x A100s
messages:

Date: 2026-05-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal conversation + capacity needs for Q3

Hi Soojin,

We’re approaching our renewal (June 30) and want to expand dedicated capacity as part of the next term. Current ask: add 6 x A100 equivalent GPUs to a reserved pool, and a throughput commitment to support peak inference of ~5k tokens/sec for our production traffic.

High level: 12-month renewal, expand reserved pool (6 GPUs), onboarding + migration assistance, and we’d like a one-time credit or discount to offset migration/setup. Can you put together a commercial and let me know if a credit/discount is possible at renewal?

Attached: draft SOW and high-level capacity forecast.

Thanks,
David

Hi David — thanks for the details and the SOW. I’ll run numbers with infra and ops to get a clean proposal (capacity pricing, throughput SLA language, and a recommended one-time credit band). Couple quick clarifying questions so we size the SLA correctly:

- Is the 5k tokens/sec peak for a single region or global (we need to know routing/replication needs)?
- Do you expect burst traffic beyond peak for short intervals (~10–15m)?
- Are you aiming to keep current Dedicated pool active + add the 6 GPUs, or migrate to a single larger reserved pool?

I’ll follow up internally and get back with a proposed amendment and a suggested credit.

Best,

Date: 2026-05-16T08:45:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Helio renewal — request for credit approval (DEAL-7294)

Team — forwarding Helio’s ask. Quick summary / ask:

- Account: Helio Health (current ARR ~$1.1M)
- Renewal date: 2026-06-30 (12‑month renewal proposed)
- Expansion: +6 A100-equivalent GPUs reserved pool (adds ~150k/mo in committed capacity)
- SLA ask: throughput guarantee to cover 5k tokens/sec peak in us-west region (they will route regionally)
- Commercial ask: Helio requests a one-time credit to offset migration/setup. They haven’t given a number; I modeled 10–20% of first-year incremental committed spend (~$60k–$120k).

Attached I’ve put the capacity calc and a draft amendment (renewal_amendment_v1.pdf).

My recommendation to win: offer a conditional one-time credit in the $60k range with the following conditions: 1) Signed amendment within 14 days, 2) Prepayment for Q1 of the expanded commitment, 3) Agreed SLA language limited to throughput (not latency SLOs) with an operational playbook.

Can we get approvals to offer $60k one-time credit (or up to $80k with CRO sign-off)? Also need legal to confirm the SLA wording.

Thanks — Soojin
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T13:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Helio renewal — request for credit approval (DEAL-7294)

Soojin — good summary. I’m generally supportive of a concession here given expansion and strong ARR profile. Approve the one-time credit at $60k, conditional on:

1) Signed amendment in 14 days (as you suggested)
2) Prepayment for first billing quarter of the incremental capacity
3) We tighten SLA language to avoid broad latency guarantees — limit to region throughput and operational escalation process; legal to sign off before we send to customer
4) Sales to include an addendum that allows Redwood to re-evaluate quantization/placement optimizations after 90 days to reduce token cost (ops/business safeguard)

If Helio pushes beyond $60k, send to me and I’ll escalate to CRO for additional credit authority. Jon — flagged you for ops input on the SLA wording. Marissa — please prepare the CS transition notes & onboarding checklist.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
